product_metadata.title: Bellagio Traditional Square Area Rug Design 401 (4 Feet X 4 Feet) Ivory.
features: Traditional design 4ft x 4ft square area rug, ivory beige.
Woven in Turkey from 100% olefin with jute backing. Designed to last for years.
Durable, lays flat, easy to maintain and clean. Stain resistant, does not shed.
Perfect for any room and decor. Will add beauty and style to your home.
Antistatic, colorfast and water repellent. Ultra-soft touch and feel.
description: High quality classic Persian vintage floral oriental, 4 ft by 4 ft square area rug. Made in Turkey from 100% olefin (polypropylene) that is durable and stain resistant. Easy to clean and vacuum (can be steam cleaned or spot cleaned with a diluted dish soap solution). Will serve as a beautiful focal point in your hallway, entryway, kitchen. Will upgrade the look and feel of your home living room bedroom. Unique design that would look great on any type of flooring.

details.Product Care Instructions: X-Vacuum or light brushing to remove dirt
